Mod.Name: More Girls
Mod.Author: 清明葬花祭|lapismind
Mod.Description: Original extension for All Girls: a milk seller (same logic as the pale scav blood seller), a fortune teller who previews the next seven days' price events and appears in the middle of the screen, and a green-cloak girl who collects weapons and medicine as donations and gives a snake ring at 500 credits. Requires All Girls (all_girls) to be enabled too (portrait).
